description: The engine answers `400` with "The storage host could not finish the command (command_capacity); its outcome may be unknown." when its storage host has no capacity for the command, seen while deleting a pool on a loaded control plane (rivet-engine 3.0.0-preview.4 on GCP). Type it as a retryable StorageCommandCapacity on every operation.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The control plane's storage host had no capacity for the command (`command_capacity`; its outcome may be unknown). Retry after a short delay.
